documentation.content: More than half of push attempts failed over the last hour, with at least 20 attempts (LLD 0 section 9). A provider outage or a bad payload; `dc_push_pruned_total` separates dead tokens from failures.

conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage.query: sum(rate({"logging.googleapis.com/user/dc_push_total", monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision", result="failed"}[1h])) / sum(rate({"logging.googleapis.com/user/dc_push_total", monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision", result=~"sent|failed"}[1h])) > 0.5 and sum(increase({"logging.googleapis.com/user/dc_push_total", monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision", result=~"sent|failed"}[1h])) >= 20
